display.purpose: Page nameplate headlines, once per page. Upright; em flips weight 300 dim.

body.purpose: Coach messages, descriptions, notes; max 65-75ch, dim.

label.purpose: Uppercase labels, kickers, nav, buttons. 9.5px, 0.07em, faint.

num.purpose: All data: pace, HR, distance, CTL/ATL/TSB. tabular-nums always.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The Lift Rule. Primary panels rise off the true-black canvas: bright inset top edge + soft cast below.

shadows.name: panel-light
shadows.purpose: Light-theme panel lift, softened for white surfaces.

shadows.name: button-accent
shadows.purpose: Reserved glow under the one accent button per screen.

motion.name: nav-indicator
motion.purpose: Active nav/tab underline fades in via opacity, never animates width.

motion.name: icon-lift
motion.purpose: Mobile tab icon lift on activate.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Live dot / sync status accent pulse.

components.name: Accent Button (Signal)
components.description: The one rationed primary per screen. Accent fill, accent-ink text, glow shadow.

components.name: Default Button (Tinted)
components.description: Standard action. Faint white tint fill, primary text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-weight: 590; padding: 9px 16px; border: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--text, #f5f5f7); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 11px; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.3,1), transform 0.18s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f833); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, dim text; faint fill + full text on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-weight: 590; padding: 9px 16px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--dim, rgba(235,235,245,0.62)); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 11px; transition: background 0.18s, color 0.18s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: var(--text, #f5f5f7); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f833); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Raised graphite field, 1px line border, 12px radius, sans text.
components.css: .ds-field { border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.11)); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #f5f5f7); background: var(--panel-2, #1e1e22); font-size: 14px; border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--faint, rgba(235,235,245,0.32)); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c6f833); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill-rounded uppercase tag. Variants: default, accent-fill (ink), accent-outline (rust).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgba(255,255,255,0.11)); font-family: var(--sans, 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; color: var(--dim, rgba(235,235,245,0.62)); border-radius: 980px; } .ds-chip--ink { background: var(--accent, #c6f833); color: var(--accent-ink, #0a0d11); border-color: var(--accent, #c6f833); } .ds-chip--rust { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c6f833) 45%, transparent); color: var(--accent, #c6f833); }

narrative.overview: Runiqlo is a precision training instrument for a single athlete, not an app skin. The interface is a true-black canvas with matte graphite panels floating on it: rounded 18px corners, hairline edges, a soft drop shadow that lifts each panel off the black, tabular mono numerals, and one tunable signal accent (lime by default) reserved for what matters now. It reads like an Apple-grade dark cockpit readout that happens to know your CTL. It rejects every fitness-app and SaaS-dashboard reflex, and rejects the lazy 'dark mode by inversion': this is a real black canvas (#000) with genuinely elevated panels, not washed grey-on-grey. The accent is rationed and tunable — swap lime for amber, cyan, or coral at runtime — but only ever one signal per screen. Dark is default; a light theme toggle (Apple system-grouped, white panels on #f2f2f7) covers bright daylight.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas (#000000) with elevated graphite panels (#151517 to #1e1e22 to #2a2a2f)
18px rounded panels (12px inner) with 1px hairline edges and a soft lifting shadow
One tunable signal accent — lime #c6f833 default, with amber / cyan / coral presets; rationed to one per screen
Two typefaces, two jobs: Space Grotesk (display, headlines, body, labels, UI) and IBM Plex Mono (every numeral)
Tabular mono numerals throughout — every metric reads like an instrument readout
Apple dual theme: dark by default, light toggle via [data-theme=light]

rules.name: The Single-Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent appears once, maybe twice, per screen. It marks the one thing that matters now: the primary action, today's workout, the live/peak metric. A screen where three things glow accent has nothing urgent.

rules.name: The Tunable-Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent is a runtime token, not a fixed brand color. Always reference var(--accent) / var(--accent-2) / var(--accent-glow) / var(--accent-ink) — never a literal #c6f833. Swapping the preset must re-tint the entire UI.

rules.name: The Apple-Zone Rule
rules.body: Zone and form hues are the Apple system palette and map one-to-one to a training meaning. Never substitute an arbitrary hue or reuse a zone color decoratively.

rules.name: The Instrument-Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every standalone numeric metric — pace, HR, distance, duration, percentage, CTL/ATL/TSB — uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so figures align like an instrument readout. Tiles, ledgers, and pills use IBM Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Weight-Is-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: With one display face, hierarchy is carried by Space Grotesk weight (300 dim to 650 accent) and the type scale — never by a second display typeface or by italic.

rules.name: The Two-Faces Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk does everything textual; IBM Plex Mono does numerals (and only numerals). No third face.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Primary panels lift off the black canvas with the panel shadow + hairline. This is intentional Apple-style elevation — do not flatten panels to borderless rectangles, and do not stack a shadowed card inside a shadowed card (use .surface-raised, tone-stepped and flat).

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Rationed Rule
rules.body: Soft accent glow (button shadow, hero gridbg, live dot) follows the Single-Signal Rule — at most one glowing element per screen.

dos: Do keep panels at 18px radius, inner blocks at 12px, pills/badges at 980px.
Do lift primary panels off the black canvas with the panel shadow + 1px hairline; use .surface-raised (flat, tone-stepped) for inner blocks.
Do set every standalone number with tabular-nums; use IBM Plex Mono for tiles, ledgers, and pills.
Do drive hierarchy with Space Grotesk weight + the type scale; keep IBM Plex Mono for numerals only.
Do ration the accent to one signal per screen: primary action, today's workout, live/peak metric, live dot.
Do reference accent via var(--accent) / var(--accent-2) / var(--accent-glow) / var(--accent-ink) so preset swaps (lime/amber/cyan/coral) re-tint everything.
Do step a graphite tone (panel to panel-2) for hover/recessed states.
Do use the Apple system zone/form palette; map each hue to exactly one training meaning.
Do support both themes — verify contrast under [data-theme=light] (white panels) and default dark.
Do respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) (handled globally) and keep transitions ~180ms, state-only.
donts: Don't hardcode the lime hex (#c6f833) or any accent literal in a component — always use the CSS var so the tunable presets work.
Don't flatten the design to grey-on-grey 'inverted' dark mode — the canvas is true black (#000) and panels genuinely lift.
Don't nest a shadowed panel inside a shadowed panel; inner blocks are .surface-raised (flat).
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or rainbow accents. Solid text or solid accent; emphasis via weight/size.
Don't revert to the old editorial 'Almanac' theme — cream paper, ink rules, Newsreader serif italic, square 0px corners. This app is a dark carbon instrument now.
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no purple gradients, no glowing identical-card grids.
Don't use fitness-influencer aesthetics: no streaks UI, no bright motivational palettes, no badge gamification.
Don't build Garmin Connect: no feature-bloat, no everything-everywhere screens.
Don't replicate Strava's blue/orange activity feed card grid — the explicit anti-reference.
Don't set numerals in the sans display weight or headlines in mono. Two faces, two jobs.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top). Use transform, opacity (e.g. nav underline animates opacity, not width).
Don't let more than one element glow accent per screen.
